result.query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('at',clock_timestamp(),'lb',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',lb_id,'state',state,'reason',reason,'observed_at',observed_at,'configuration_state',configuration_state)) FROM network_load_balancers WHERE state<>'deleted'),'base',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b)) FROM network_vpc_base_connectivity b WHERE state<>'deleted'),'attachments',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',attachment_id,'state',state,'reason',reason,'observed_at',observed_at,'protocol_blocked',protocol_blocked)) FROM network_attachments WHERE state<>'released'));
